headline: Executive order signed March 13, 2026, on truthful advertising of products claimed to be made in America.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order deals with making sure "Made in America" or "Made in USA" claims on products are truthful. No summary was provided, so the specific actions, agencies involved, and any new rules or enforcement steps are not known from the available information.

who_it_affects.group: Companies that label or advertise products as made in the United States
who_it_affects.how: They may face closer review or enforcement of whether their "Made in USA" claims are accurate.

who_it_affects.group: Shoppers who look for American-made products
who_it_affects.how: The order appears aimed at making "Made in USA" labels they see more reliable.
